title: The Quiet Radiators
author: Jonah Underhill
blurb: Paloma Nystrom, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
